fields.summary_ko.0: GF Securities lowered Dell (DELL) target price to $341 and maintained 'Hold' rating, assessing meaningful upside potential as limited given stock price decline of over 45% year-to-date.
fields.summary_ko.1: Enterprise server shipments in 2027 are expected to decline 9%, with difficulty in recovery due to weak PC shipments, and next quarter revenue forecast of $5.4B and EPS of $7.18.
